snippet: Initial mechanical specs received for 'Portal Node'.
Bezel fabrication cost shock: $2,500 per unit confirmed.
Thermal debate: Holes vs. Chassis Conduction for 'Zeus' server.
Case closure methodology study initiated.
Consultant Agreement signed: 'Galaxy Home Network' formalized.
Governance friction: Manager demands accounting of 21 billed hours.
THERMAL CRISIS: Simulation confirms 150W load. CPU at 84.0°C.
Smart Card 'Dead Zone' identified at 55.0°C. Relocation required.
Tooling Feasibility: Hexagonal hole pattern requested for airflow.
Galaxy BOM generated. Delta WFB1212H fan specified.
Power Supply structural support failure identified.
Invoice generated: 26 hours spent on 'Hitlist' incorporation.
YIELD CRISIS: Vendor flags chassis warping due to 'drawn standoffs'.
CPU 'Puck' Assembly files released. Interference issues noted.
Proto files uploaded to 'ftp.mechanistic.com' (WebTV server full).
QA Deviation Report: Base sheet metal does not match CAD.
THE HITLIST: 30+ defects (AC alignment, EMI gaps, Assembly blocks).
Database sync: 'Could not get on the share ftp site'.
Galaxy design 'close to finished'. Pivot to 'Mercury LC' begins.
Galaxy 'wrapped up'. CPU assembly review requested.
PROJECT TERMINATION: 'Harsh restructuring' and layoffs confirmed.
source_ref: The Galaxy Project: The Rise and Fall... [21]
